timing_note: Preserve native duration, interpolate poses to actual 120 Hz; do not just relabel FPS or change speed.
selection_method: Initial automatic candidate screening: Official LAFAN1 FK in meters/+Z up; same-foot swing peaks at least 0.85s apart with prominence>=2.5cm, exactly one opposite swing per stride, native mean speed 0.4-1.1m/s, speed CV<=0.25, straightness>=0.975, smoothed heading range<=25deg, estimated flight<=8%. Final windows were reviewed with actual target-model IK and source posture diagnostics. Per-clip reselection_method, event_method, source_stats and selection_qc_notes describe any relaxed thresholds or alternate gait phase detection used to avoid deep crouch and prolonged target joint saturation; the initial rules do not apply to every final replacement.
contact_note: Foot contact is a kinematic heuristic: min(Foot_z,Toe_z) < clip 5th-percentile height+4cm and foot speed<0.7m/s; not measured ground forces.

clips.cycle_definition: A stride cycle is one same-foot swing peak to the next same-foot swing peak, not a single left/right step.
